description: This Java class handles creation of office transactions within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface to process commands related to office transactions and delegates the actual transaction logic to the OfficeWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateOfficeTransactionCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the creation of office transactions by processing commands and delegating to the OfficeWritePlatformService.

methods.name: CreateOfficeTransactionCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the OfficeWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to create an office transaction and returns the result.
